_doc: Gig templates for the fixer board (M6, M9 P3). Each offer picks a template (its kind), a security level weighted by the crew's best Reputation (CPR p193, per character; rep_for_security), then a canon Night City location of that level (data/world/locations.json: hooks naming the kind first, else places whose gigs include it) and a Fixer working its district (data/world/fixers.json; fixer_tags: which deals_in tags suit each kind, weighted up). The title is the template's label and the location; the blurb is '<Fixer> has work at <Location> (<District>): <hook>', or the template's pitch when the place has no hook for the kind. Every offer is at a canon location (owner ruling 2026-11-04: no generic offers): when no place fits the template's kind at the rolled level or below, the other kinds are tried. Pay and rewards are HOUSE-RULE economy numbers until checked against the book's job rates. Unique offers (spec: 'occasional unique offers' from fixers who trust you) appear once the crew's best Reputation reaches unique_rep, at one of the target's own places (else a canon place for the job); their titles/blurb fill {fixer}, {corp}, {gang}, {data} and {place} (the location's name). Target factions come from data/world/factions.json (each faction lists the gig kinds it can be the target of); {corp}/{gang} slots are filled with the target's name, and titles naming the other kind of slot are skipped. Complications are no longer here: the book's Hardened complication tables (data/rules/npcs.json) are rolled at gig start (Complication).

unique_templates.blurb: {fixer} trusts you with this one. A {corp} prototype is in storage tonight; bring it back. Double pay.
{fixer} wants the {gang} gone for good. Their main crew is at the {place}. Double pay.
{fixer}'s client wants {corp}'s {data}. Expect a deep NET and heavy Black ICE. Double pay.

tower._why: HOUSE-RULE (owner 2026-11-08: tower gigs are rare and gated to later progression, with a good mix of high-rise and ordinary gigs). Once the crew's best Reputation reaches rep (4: known all over the local area, CPR p.193), one board in chance_in carries one tower offer (Campaign._tower_offer), in place of its last ordinary offer. A tower job pays its level's rate times pay_mult (the ride up is part of the risk). One tower gig in day_in plays by day, the rest at night (owner, V1 verdicts 2026-11-09: some campaign tower gigs by day; night stays the campaign look), drawn from the gig's seed and kept on the gig as sky (Campaign.tower_sky).
